# What the data-dict export loses: General Social Survey

The YAML files here follow data-dict spec 0.1.0. They describe the common data format, so they validate against its parquet files. The records in `metadata/` remain canonical. This table counts what the export drops or flattens into text.

| | `7224r3a` | `7224r3` |
|---|---|---|
| variables exported | 6,943 | 6,942 |
| variables whose numeric code labels went to `details` (no labeled numeric codes) | 6,319 | 6,318 |
| missing or unresolved codes, typed only in the `__code` column's labels | 26,786 | 26,796 |
| variables listed by name only (no type the records can support) | 621 | 621 |
| availability entries (wave by form, with n), summarized as one line of text | 58,293 | 58,210 |
| corrections applied; only the corrected text is exported | 4 | 4 |
| field origins (publisher, data file, rule, hand, model) not exported | 34,973 | 34,964 |
| groups (batteries, subjects, sections), not exported | 654 | 654 |
| links between releases, not exported | 6,974 | 6,974 |
| derived properties (scale signatures), not exported | 1,341 | 1,341 |
| release id not expressible as data-dict `version` (needs semver or a date) | 1 | 1 |
